title: Symplectic blenders near whiskered tori and persistence of saddle-center homoclinics
summary: A blender is a hyperbolic basic set such that the projection of its stable/unstable set onto some center subspace has a higher topological dimension than the set itself. We prove that, for any $C^s$ symplectic diffeomorphism (where $s=2,\dots\infty,ω$), if it has a one-dimensional whiskered torus with a homoclinic orbit, then a symplectic blender can be created by an arbitrarily $C^s$-small perturbation.
